subject: Quick note on I & N Fabrication's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and I & N Fabrication stood out.

Shirebrook structural steel on Vernon Street Industrial Estate - and infabs.co.uk still ships as HTML 4.01 Transitional, still carries a Copyright 2009 meta mark, still points visitors to Multimap, and still publishes Fax: 01623 741177 beside sales@infabs.co.uk. Serious East Midlands fabrication and site steelwork; a front end frozen like a late-2000s brochure with a live fax line.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
